description: Create a payment priced in USD or EUR and return the CigalPay checkout link to send to the customer. The customer chooses the coin on the checkout page; the rate is locked for 30 minutes. Maximum 5,000 per payment.

description.description: Shown to the customer, e.g. "Logo design - invoice 1042"

fee_paid_by.description: Who pays the processing fee: 'customer' adds it to the price the customer pays. Omit to use the dashboard setting

notify_url.description: Public HTTPS URL that receives signed payment notifications

order_id.description: Your reference for this payment (generated if omitted)

return_url.description: Where the customer goes after paying

name: create_checkout
title: Create a crypto payment link
